thread:
dev-runtime-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high NotReady node count in inference-pool-us-west-2 (3 nodes) - auto-escalating to oncall

maria: seeing 502/503s for a subset of requests hitting gpu instances, also increased p95 latency. is this the node-flap again?

jamal: paging oncall (pd-bot invoked) - I'm on it, grabbing logs now.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident assigned to jamal (oncall). Severity: Sev2. Trigger: node NotReady flaps affecting inference-pool.

elias: adding context: earlier today we saw a kernel module oops on two nodes, might be driver related.

jamal: confirmed kubelet restarts on nodes inf-gpu-12/13/14. dmesg shows GPU fault and subsequent OOM killer activity. copying logs: 
```
Mar 15 09:01:43 inf-gpu-12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=2345, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 09:01:44 inf-gpu-12 kubelet[1234]: E0322 09:01:44.123456   1234 server.go:123] runtime service not responding: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing"
Mar 15 09:01:45 inf-gpu-12 kubelet[1234]: Kubelet has been killed (OOM?) restarting...
```

mar ia: wow. so driver Xid 79 again. we've seen that cause container crashes and kubelet restarts before.

tina: quick customer impact check: which tenants are on those nodes? any paid customers in the loop?

elias: primarily lower-tier sandbox workloads and a few small prod customers on dedicated-shared pools. I see three customer IDs with increased error rates: cust-772, cust-1284, cust-aws-phi.

maria: cust-aws-phi reported degraded chat latency around 09:02 UTC, support ticket 8932 opened.

jamal: mitigation plan: cordon affected nodes, drain safe pods, scale up inference autoscaler with more non-gpu fallbacks, and trigger fallback routing to cpu-quantized model variant in us-west-2 for affected routes. calling for a hotfix on driver/AMIs if we need to reprovision.

ops-bot: runbook hint: /runbook node-flap -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/node-flap - recommended actions: cordon -> drain -> replace node -> check driver versions.

jamal: executing cordon now on inf-gpu-12 and inf-gpu-13
```
kubectl cordon inf-gpu-12
kubectl cordon inf-gpu-13
kubectl drain inf-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

jamal: drain started. moving traffic off these nodes.

maria: I'm updating status page draft: "Partial availability for inference in us-west-2; affecting chat and batch jobs for a subset of customers. Engineers are mitigating."

jamal: noticed restart loops for our runtime container on inf-gpu-14 during drain; kubelet restarts mid-drain so pods bounced. stack shows `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` in logs. snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T09:03:12Z runtime[pid=2345]: cuda: driver report: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION at inference_worker.cu:432
2026-03-15T09:03:12Z runtime[pid=2345]: worker crashed, exit code 139
```

elias: illegal instruction + Xid 79 suggests a driver/firmware mismatch or GPU memory poisoned. Let's not attempt in-place driver reload on-prod nodes; safer to replace AMI.

tina: can we spin up standby nodes with the known-good AMI and migrate pods?

jamal: starting a parallel node group with AMI v2026-02-11 (known-good), cluster-autoscaler triggered with label node-type=standby-gpu.

ops-bot: Infra action started: launching 3 standby nodes (ami v2026-02-11) in us-west-2. Estimated join time ~3m.

maria: ops update to customers: adding note that we are redirecting some requests to fallback models to preserve latency SLOs where possible.

elias: also enabling prefix KV cache warmup on fallback routes to keep token cost low.

jamal: after two minutes, new nodes joined. starting node replacement: cordon inf-gpu-14, then replace. we will drain once kubelet stable.

jamal: action: taint old nodes so scheduler won't place new pods: 
```
kubectl taint nodes inf-gpu-12 redwood/needs-replace=true:NoSchedule
kubectl taint nodes inf-gpu-13 redwood/needs-replace=true:NoSchedule
kubectl taint nodes inf-gpu-14 redwood/needs-replace=true:NoSchedule
```

elias: rolling replacement in flight. also running `kubectl describe node` to capture last-state events for RCA.

maria: support message posted to ticket 8932 with mitigation ETA ~15m and workaround instructions (use cpu-fallback route or smaller model).

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident reassigned to tina for customer comms.

tina: acknowledged, I'll keep customers posted. support is copying SLO impact.

jamal: after replacements, we see normal scheduling and no Xid logs on new nodes. verifying runtime health probes passing.

elias: let's capture meminfo and driver versions for the old nodes before terminating: 
```
# on inf-gpu-12
uname -a: Linux inf-gpu-12 5.15.0-rt
nvidia-smi -q | grep -E "Driver Version|CUDA Version"
Driver Version                        : 515.76
CUDA Version                          : 11.3
```

elias: the new AMI uses driver 525.85 and CUDA 11.8. older driver 515 had a known regression with certain card firmware causing Xid 79 under high-concurrency pkts.

jamal: tagging as potential RCA: outdated drivers surfaced under bursty inference workload -> GPU fault -> kubelet restart -> node flaps.

maria: incident timeline and customer impact note drafted. will include ticket numbers and who was paged.

ops-bot: automatic metric alert cleared: NotReady node count back to normal.

jamal: closing mitigation loop: replaced 3 nodes, scaled replicas back down, removed temporary autoscaler bump, cleared taints on new nodes.

elias: follow-ups: schedule cluster image update for all inference pools, add driver-version health check to node-provisioner, adjust autoscaler to prefer standby-gpu AMI for future bursts.

tina: I'll coordinate customer-facing postmortem with SRE and support; provisional impact: 12 customers with elevated errors for ~12 minutes, one support P1 opened.

maria: thanks everyone. will mark incident resolved in the ticket once postmortem doc is drafted. :white_check_mark:

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved by jamal.

maria: quick retros: we need an automated AMI rotation plan and a runbook step to prefer replacement over in-place driver reload for Xid 79. noted in infra backlog. :memo:
